system.description:
Tasting wine and discerning its flavors and properties is a highly refined skill. Use the skill to determine the origins of the wine.

Obstacles: Grape, Ob 1. Terroir, Ob 2. Vintage, Ob 3. Estate, Ob 4. These obstacles are modified by the quality and age of the wine: Drinkable, +1 Ob. Swill, +2 Ob. Old, +1 Ob. Ancient, +2 Ob.

Skill Type: Special. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 309
